resources.string: Set up mail encryption with PGP

MailFox creates a PGP key pair for the account and publishes the public key on keys.openpgp.org so that others can send you encrypted messages. Received encrypted messages are decrypted automatically.
Key created. keys.openpgp.org has sent a confirmation email to %s. Please open the link in it so that others can find your key.
Key created, but it could not be published (no connection?). Please try \"Publish again\" later.

The exported file is protected with this password. You need it to import the key into another program (e.g. Thunderbird, OpenKeychain, GnuPG). Keep the file and the password in a safe place – anyone who has both can read your encrypted messages.
The password must have at least 8 characters.
The key is protected with a password. Please enter the password that was used when exporting the key.
Key imported. A previous key is kept to read older messages. Use \"Publish again\" if others should find the imported key.
The file doesn\'t contain a private key.
The key doesn\'t belong to the email address of this account.
The key can\'t be used (revoked, expired or not suitable for encryption).
